description: Two four-pole transistor ladder low-pass filters, modelled stage by stage on the Moog circuit, sharing one set of controls

params.text: Sets the corner frequency, from 20Hz to 18000Hz, spaced by ear so that each turn covers about the same musical interval
Scales what the cutoff jack does, reaching one octave per volt at its maximum
Sets the resonance, from none to the point where the filter rings on its own
Scales what the resonance jack does, 5V covering the whole resonance range at its maximum
Sets how hard the signal is pushed into the transistor stages, from silence to 12dB above unity, with 0dB in the middle of its travel
Scales what the drive jack does, 5V covering the whole drive range at its maximum

inputs.text: One of the two signals to be filtered; it is filtered on its own and reaches only the output on its own side
Moves the corner frequency, an octave per volt with its attenuator at maximum
Adds to the resonance, scaled by its attenuator, with the total clamped between none and full
Adds to the drive, scaled by its attenuator, with the total clamped between silence and 12dB
One of the two signals to be filtered; it is filtered on its own and reaches only the output on its own side

outputs.text: The filtered version of the input on the same side
The filtered version of the input on the same side

notes: the two halves share every knob and every CV jack; only the signal path is separate, so this is a stereo filter rather than two independent ones.
each half is mono: a polyphonic cable is read as its first channel.
a half whose output is unpatched is not computed at all and its output is held at 0V, so patching only one side halves the work.
the resonance is tuned for the four-pole configuration, so the filter self-oscillates near the top of the RESONANCE knob rather than at its very end.
the filter runs at eight times the sample rate below a 50kHz engine rate, four times below 100kHz, twice below 200kHz and once above that.
if a stage ever produces a value that is not a number, or one beyond ±100, that half is silenced for a sample and all its state is cleared, so it recovers by itself.
each of the three large knobs draws a gold arc from its own position round to where its CV jack and attenuator have moved it.
menu: Auto level — divides the output by the drive setting, so that turning the drive up adds saturation without adding loudness
